description: This grouped bar chart illustrates the Module Giga FLOPs for different computational components across three Audio back-end Conformer Stages. The horizontal category axis, labeled "Audio back-end Conformer Stage", displays three sequential stages: "Stage 1 (d=180, n=500)", "Stage 2 (d=256, n=250)", and "Stage 3 (d=360, n=125)". The vertical value axis, labeled "Module Giga FLOPs", uses a linear scale ranging from 0 to 0.3, with numeric tick labels at regular intervals of 0.1 and corresponding horizontal grid lines. The chart features grouped bars, with each stage containing a cluster of four adjacent bars representing different module types, as indicated by a legend at the top. The legend identifies a blue bar corresponding to a redacted or missing label (shown as a solid grey rectangle), a red bar for "grouped attention (g=3)", a yellow bar for "patch attention (k=3)", and a green bar for "feed-forward". Within the groups, the blue bars show values of approximately 0.28 in Stage 1, 0.16 in Stage 2, and 0.12 in Stage 3, making the blue bar in Stage 1 the tallest overall. The red "grouped attention (g=3)" bars measure roughly 0.16, 0.12, and 0.11 across the respective stages. The yellow "patch attention (k=3)" bars are the shortest in each group, with values of about 0.12, 0.11, and 0.10, the latter being the shortest bar overall in Stage 3. The green "feed-forward" bars maintain a consistent height of approximately 0.13 across all three stages. The x-axis categories are ordered sequentially by stage number, and the bars within each group follow a fixed order of blue, red, yellow, and green from left to right, with no additional visual emphasis applied to any specific bars.
